name: ReelForge
summary: Your own streaming service: movies and TV on every screen, with duplicates found and files shrunk for you.
description: ReelForge streams your movies and shows to TVs, phones and browsers, converting on the graphics card when a device needs it. Its Media Manager finds duplicate copies and re-encodes files to take up far less space, keeping every audio track and subtitle. Apps for Google TV and Roku sign in to it directly.

ports.label: Lets TV apps find the server on your network

storage.label: Settings, accounts, watch history and library database
Artwork cache and conversions in progress

inputs.label: Movies and TV folder
inputs.help: The folder that holds your movies and shows (subfolders are fine). It appears inside ReelForge as /media, so add your libraries from there.
inputs.accessReason: Space Saver replaces files with smaller copies and Duplicates moves extra copies into a holding folder, so ReelForge needs to write here.

inputs.label: Another media folder (optional)
inputs.help: Use this if your shows live somewhere else, for example a second share. It appears inside ReelForge as /media2.

gpu.help: With a graphics card, ReelForge converts video for phones and TVs many times faster and uses far less CPU.

firstRun: Open ReelForge, create your admin account, then add libraries from /media (and /media2 if you chose a second folder).
